description: React component for displaying detailed network resource information including headers, payload, and response, with support for copying request data in various formats and rendering response content such as images and fonts.

classes.name: RequestBody
classes.description: Type representing the request body with text and optional MIME type.

classes.name: CopyDropdown
classes.description: Component providing options to copy network request data in different formats.

classes.name: ExpandableSection
classes.description: Component for expandable sections displaying headers, query parameters, or request body.

classes.name: HeadersTab
classes.description: Tab component showing request and response headers along with general request info.

classes.name: PayloadTab
classes.description: Tab component displaying request payload, query string parameters, or message indicating no payload.

classes.name: ResponseTab
classes.description: Tab component rendering response content, including images, fonts, or text.

classes.name: FontPreview
classes.description: Component for previewing font files embedded in response content.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on HTTP status code for color coding.

methods.name: formatXml
methods.description: Formats XML string with indentation for readability.

methods.name: formatBody
methods.description: Formats response body based on content type, handling JSON, XML, and URL-encoded data.
